# Slint license notice

QuickFolder uses Slint `1.18.0` for its desktop user interface under the **Slint Royalty-free Desktop, Mobile, and Web Applications License 2.0**.

- Upstream release: <https://github.com/slint-ui/slint/releases/tag/v1.18.0>
- Canonical license at that release: <https://github.com/slint-ui/slint/blob/v1.18.0/LICENSES/LicenseRef-Slint-Royalty-free-2.0.md>
- Vendored Git blob SHA-1: `f087009734518f4b71987ca43915af1d9ed76547`

The vendored license text is copied unchanged and is included in portable release packages. QuickFolder also keeps Slint's `AboutSlint` attribution accessible in the application as required by the selected license option.
